prior_scientific_decisions.quote: I also apply my test to a new eBay data set of 552 new movie-DVD auctions. I find significant overbidding here (23 percent of auctions), but a close connection between wording and overbidding as well. In summary, my reading of the evidence is that the auctions and low-price BINs sometimes do not appear together on the same webpage. This is most clear for the M&L cross section and my DVD data set, but is also a distinct possibility for the Cashflow 101 data set. I examine this condition because of its key importance in M&L for the conclusion of nonstandard behavior and its relevance for assessing the importance of search costs.
prior_scientific_decisions.reason: The replication confirms significant overbidding (and the absence of learning with experience) in a new 552-auction eBay dataset, but its central message is that the original study's identifying assumption fails and that the observed overbidding is explained by standard search costs rather than validly identifying nonstandard behavior.
